mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 217.5 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 217.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment above 130,000 (thousands) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction below 670 (thousands) signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 670, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 102 (index) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 102, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
